name: 2-(1-methyl-3-indolyl)ethanamine
summary: 1-Methyltryptamine (1-methyl-T, 1-MT or 1-Me-T; code name PAL-637) is a serotonin receptor agonist and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 1-methyl derivative of tryptamine (T; PAL-235).

pharmacology.text: 1-Methyltryptamine (1-methyl-T, 1-MT or 1-Me-T; code name PAL-637) is a serotonin receptor agonist and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. Its activities at other serotonin receptors were not reported.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent

uses.text: Analogues of 1-methyltryptamine, like 1-methylserotonin and 1-iPr-5-MeO-T, have been studied.

fact.en: It is tryptamine with a methyl group on the ring nitrogen. Tryptamine itself is made in the body and in many plants from the amino acid tryptophan.
fact.zh: 它是在環氮上帶有甲基的色胺。色胺本身在人體和許多植物中由胺基酸色胺酸製成。
fact.zhHans: 它是在环氮上带有甲基的色胺。色胺本身在人体和许多植物中由胺基酸色胺酸制成。
